dfm_alerts.description: Weather seals and cable glands are listed, but the shell joint has no gasket groove, compression stops, or leak-test requirement. Outdoor water ingress could reach the PCB and battery.
dfm_alerts.fix: Define the gasket profile, gland interfaces, compression stops, target ingress rating, and assembled leak test.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Verify enclosure ingress protection by test — IEC 60529.

dfm_alerts.description: The rechargeable battery and solar charge controller have no specified cell chemistry, protection, charging limits, or temperature limits.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify the cell and a compatible charge controller, protection functions, temperature sensing, and charging verification.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary cells and batteries — IEC 62133-2 (if lithium-based).

dfm_alerts.description: Battery retention and routing are undefined; the cell or leads could move or be pinched when the shells are closed.
dfm_alerts.fix: Add a restrained battery pocket, insulating barriers, wire channels, and assembly clearance checks.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Prevent mechanical damage and short circuits in battery installations — IEC 62133-2 (if lithium-based).

dfm_alerts.description: The valve drive is not specified beyond the valve, MOSFET, and diode. Coil voltage, current, startup demand, and solar/battery power budget cannot be checked.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify the valve coil and duty cycle; verify the regulator, battery, MOSFET, diode, wiring, and connectors across the operating range.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Select semiconductor operating conditions within rated limits — AO3400A and SS14 manufacturer datasheets.

dfm_alerts.description: The specified boss pilot and self-tapping screws lack a boss outer diameter, engagement depth, screw type, and torque limit; cracking or stripped bosses may result.
dfm_alerts.fix: Dimension the bosses and engagement for the selected screw, then validate installation and strip torque in molded ASA samples.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Size pilot holes and bosses for the selected thread-forming screw and plastic — STANLEY Engineered Fastening plastics fastening design guide.

dfm_alerts.description: The ASA housing has no declared flammability grade despite enclosing a rechargeable battery and electronics.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify and qualify an ASA grade with a flammability classification appropriate to the completed product's safety assessment.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Classify plastic material flammability using standardized burning tests — UL 94.

dfm_alerts.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.46°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Matte texture · Warm white #EDEBE6') needs.
dfm_alerts.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 173.84 mm² (curved, 277.52 mm² at [-64.98, 19.98, 11.69]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

dfm_alerts.description: Projected area along +Z: 8805 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 45.0 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
dfm_alerts.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 60 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

dfm_alerts.description: Measured wall 2.00-2.00 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
dfm_alerts.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

questions.en: DFM major — Weather seals and cable glands are listed, but the shell joint has no gasket groove, compression stops, or leak-test requirement. Outdoor water ingress could reach the PCB and battery. Proposed fix: Define the gasket profile, gland interfaces, compression stops, target ingress rating, and assembled leak test. Can you accommodate this, and at what cost or lead-time impact?
questions.cn: DFM重大问题 — 清单中列出了防水密封圈和电缆防水接头，但外壳接合处没有密封圈槽、压缩限位结构或泄漏测试要求。户外进水可能到达PCB和电池。建议方案：定义密封圈截面形状、防水接头接口、压缩限位结构、目标防护等级以及成品泄漏测试。贵方能否满足此要求？对成本和交期有何影响？

build_strategy.title: Module assembly
build_strategy.explanation: You design the product around bought-in, pre-certified modules (e.g. motor + driver, battery pack, radio module, heater + fan): your work is the architecture, the enclosure, the integration and the software; the factory assembles the modules into your parts. Faster and cheaper than designing every sub-system, and the modules' certifications carry part of the compliance.

not_customisable: Solenoid valves, soil probes, Wi-Fi/BLE module
